049        public static float DEFENSE_BONUS_BASE = 0.5f;
050        public static float DEFENSE_BONUS_BATTLESTATION = 1f; 
051        public static float DEFENSE_BONUS_FORTRESS = 2f;
052        
053        public static float IMPROVE_STABILITY_BONUS = 1f; 
054        
055        public void apply() {
056                super.apply(false);
057                
058                int size = 3;
059                
060                boolean battlestation = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_BATTLESTATION);
061                boolean starfortress = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_STARFORTRESS);
062                if (battlestation) {
063                        size = 5;
064                } else if (starfortress) {
065                        size = 7;
066                }
067                
068                modifyStabilityWithBaseMod();           
069                
070                applyIncomeAndUpkeep(size);
071                
072                demand(Commodities.CREW, size);
073                demand(Commodities.SUPPLIES, size);
074                
075                float mult = getDeficitMult(Commodities.SUPPLIES);
076                String extra = "";
077                if (mult != 1) {
078                        String com = getMaxDeficit(Commodities.SUPPLIES).one;
079                        extra = " (" + getDeficitText(com).toLowerCase() + ")";
080                }
081                float bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_BASE;
082                if (battlestation) bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_BATTLESTATION;
083                else if (starfortress) bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_FORTRESS;
084                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.GROUND_DEFENSES_MOD)
085                                                .modifyMult(getModId(), 1f + bonus * mult, getNameForModifier() + extra);
086                
087                matchCommanderToAICore(aiCoreId);
088                
089                if (!isFunctional()) {
090                        supply.clear();
091                        unapply();
092                } else {
093                        applyCRToStation();
094                }
095        }

108        protected void applyCRToStation() {
109                if (stationFleet != null) {
110                        float cr = getCR();
111                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : stationFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
112                                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(cr);
113                        }
114                        FleetInflater inflater = stationFleet.getInflater();
115                        if (inflater != null) {
116                                if (stationFleet.isInflated()) {
117                                        stationFleet.deflate();
118                                }
119                                inflater.setQuality(Misc.getShipQuality(market));
120                                if (inflater instanceof DefaultFleetInflater) {
121                                        DefaultFleetInflater dfi = (DefaultFleetInflater) inflater;
122                                        ((DefaultFleetInflaterParams)dfi.getParams()).allWeapons = true;
123                                }
124                        }
125                }
126        }
127        
128        protected float getCR() {
129                float deficit = getMaxDeficit(Commodities.CREW, Commodities.SUPPLIES).two;
130                float demand = Math.max(getDemand(Commodities.CREW).getQuantity().getModifiedInt(),
131                                                                getDemand(Commodities.SUPPLIES).getQuantity().getModifiedInt());
132                
133                if (deficit < 0) deficit = 0f;
134                if (demand < 1) {
135                        demand = 1;
136                        deficit = 0f;
137                }
138                
139                
140                float q = Misc.getShipQuality(market);
141                if (q < 0) q = 0;
142                if (q > 1) q = 1;
143                
144                float d = (demand - deficit) / demand;
145                if (d < 0) d = 0;
146                if (d > 1) d = 1;
147                
148                //float cr = 0.2f + 0.4f * d + 0.4f * q;
149                //float cr = 0.2f + 0.8f * Math.min(d, q);
150                float cr = 0.5f + 0.5f * Math.min(d, q);
151                if (cr > 1) cr = 1;
152                
153                return cr;
154        }

163        protected void addPostDemandSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean hasDemand, IndustryTooltipMode mode) {
164                //if (mode == IndustryTooltipMode.NORMAL && isFunctional()) {
165                if (mode != IndustryTooltipMode.NORMAL || isFunctional()) {
166                        Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
167                        float opad = 10f;
168                        
169                        float cr = getCR();
170                        tooltip.addPara("Station combat readiness: %s", opad, h, "" + Math.round(cr * 100f) + "%");
171                        
172                        addStabilityPostDemandSection(tooltip, hasDemand, mode);
173                        
174                        boolean battlestation = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_BATTLESTATION);
175                        boolean starfortress = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_STARFORTRESS);
176                        float bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_BASE;
177                        if (battlestation) bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_BATTLESTATION;
178                        else if (starfortress) bonus = DEFENSE_BONUS_FORTRESS;
179                        addGroundDefensesImpactSection(tooltip, bonus, Commodities.SUPPLIES);
180                }
181        }

293        @Override
294        protected void upgradeFinished(Industry previous) {
295                super.upgradeFinished(previous);
296                
297                if (previous instanceof OrbitalStation) {
298                        OrbitalStation prev = (OrbitalStation) previous;
299                        stationEntity = prev.stationEntity;
300                        stationFleet = prev.stationFleet;
301                        usingExistingStation = prev.usingExistingStation;
302                        
303                        if (stationFleet != null) {
304                                stationFleet.removeEventListener(prev);
305                                stationFleet.addEventListener(this);
306                        }
307                        
308                        if (stationEntity != null && stationFleet != null) {
309                                matchStationAndCommanderToCurrentIndustry();
310                        } else {
311                                spawnStation();
312                        }
313                }
314        }

316        protected void removeStationEntityAndFleetIfNeeded() {
317                if (stationEntity != null) {
318                        stationEntity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.STATION_FLEET);
319                        stationEntity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.STATION_BASE_FLEET);
320                        
321                        stationEntity.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(stationFleet);
322                        
323                        if (stationEntity.getContainingLocation() != null && !usingExistingStation) {
324                                stationEntity.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(stationEntity);
325                                market.getConnectedEntities().remove(stationEntity);
326                                
327                                // commented out so that MarketCMD doesn't NPE if you destroy a market through bombardment of a station
328                                //stationEntity.setMarket(null);
329                                
330                        } else if (stationEntity.hasTag(Tags.USE_STATION_VISUAL)) {
331                                ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)stationEntity).setFleetForVisual(null);
332                                float origRadius = ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)stationEntity).getCustomEntitySpec().getDefaultRadius();
333                                ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)stationEntity).setRadius(origRadius);
334                        }
335                        
336                        if (stationFleet != null) {
337                                stationFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.STATION_MARKET);
338                                stationFleet.removeEventListener(this);
339                        }
340                        
341                        stationEntity = null;
342                        stationFleet = null;
343                }
344        }

358        protected void spawnStation() {
359                FleetParamsV3 fParams = new FleetParamsV3(null, null,
360                                                                                                  market.getFactionId(),
361                                                                                                  1f,
362                                                                                                  FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL,
363                                                                                                  0,
364                                                                                                  0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
365                fParams.allWeapons = true;
366                
367                removeStationEntityAndFleetIfNeeded();
368                
369//              if (market.getId().equals("jangala")) {
370//                      System.out.println("wefwefew");
371//              }
372                
373                stationFleet = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(fParams);
374                //stationFleet.setName(getCurrentName());
375                stationFleet.setNoFactionInName(true);
376                
377                
378                stationFleet.setStationMode(true);
379                
380                //stationFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_ALLOW_DISENGAGE, true);
381                
382                // needed for AI fleets to engage it, as they engage the hidden station fleet, unlike
383                // the player that interacts with the stationEntity
384                stationFleet.clearAbilities();
385                stationFleet.addAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER);
386                stationFleet.getAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER).activate();
387                stationFleet.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", 10000f);
388                
389                stationFleet.setAI(null);
390                stationFleet.addEventListener(this);
391
392                
393                ensureStationEntityIsSetOrCreated();
394                
395                if (stationEntity instanceof CustomCampaignEntityAPI) {
396                        if (!usingExistingStation || stationEntity.hasTag(Tags.USE_STATION_VISUAL)) {
397                                ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)stationEntity).setFleetForVisual(stationFleet);
398                        }
399                }
400                
401                stationFleet.setCircularOrbit(stationEntity, 0, 0, 100);
402                stationFleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.STATION_MARKET, market);
403                stationFleet.setHidden(true);
404                
405                
406                matchStationAndCommanderToCurrentIndustry();
407        }

409        
410        protected void ensureStationEntityIsSetOrCreated() {
411                if (stationEntity == null) {
412                        for (SectorEntityToken entity : market.getConnectedEntities()) {
413                                if (entity.hasTag(Tags.STATION) && !entity.hasTag("NO_ORBITAL_STATION")) { // added NO_ORBITAL_STATION per modder request 
414                                        stationEntity = entity;
415                                        usingExistingStation = true;
416                                        break;
417                                }
418                        }
419                }
420                
421                if (stationEntity == null) {
422                        stationEntity = market.getContainingLocation().addCustomEntity(
423                                        null, market.getName() + " Station", Entities.STATION_BUILT_FROM_INDUSTRY, market.getFactionId());
424                        SectorEntityToken primary = market.getPrimaryEntity();
425                        float orbitRadius = primary.getRadius() + 150f;
426                        stationEntity.setCircularOrbitWithSpin(primary, (float) Math.random() * 360f, orbitRadius, orbitRadius / 10f, 5f, 5f);
427                        market.getConnectedEntities().add(stationEntity);
428                        stationEntity.setMarket(market);
429                }
430        }

433        protected void matchStationAndCommanderToCurrentIndustry() {
434                if (stationFleet == null) return;
435                
436                stationFleet.getFleetData().clear();
437                
438                String fleetName = null;
439                String variantId = null;
440                float radius = 60f;
441                
442                try {
443                        JSONObject json = new JSONObject(getSpec().getData());
444                        variantId = json.getString("variant");
445                        radius = (float) json.getDouble("radius");
446                        fleetName = json.getString("fleetName");
447                } catch (JSONException e) {
448                        throw new RuntimeException(e);
449                }
450                
451                if (stationEntity != null) {
452                        fleetName = stationEntity.getName();
453                }
454                
455                
456                stationFleet.setName(fleetName);
457                
458//              try {
459//                      FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variantId);
460//              } catch (Throwable t) {
461//                      throw new RuntimeException("Market: " + market.getId() + ", variantId: " + variantId + ", " +
462//                                      "message: [" + t.getMessage() + "]");
463//              }
464                
465                FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, variantId);
466                //String name = stationFleet.getFleetData().pickShipName(member, null);
467                String name = fleetName;
468                member.setShipName(name);
469                
470                stationFleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
471                
472//              int level = 20;
473//              PersonAPI commander = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(
474//                              Global.getSector().getFaction(market.getFactionId()), level, true);
475//              commander.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.GUNNERY_IMPLANTS, 3);
476//              stationFleet.setCommander(commander);
477//              stationFleet.getFlagship().setCaptain(commander);
478                
479                //stationFleet.getFlagship().getRepairTracker().setCR(stationFleet.getFlagship().getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
480                applyCRToStation();
481                
482                //stationFleet.setMarket(market);
483                
484                //JSONObject
485                
486                if (!usingExistingStation && stationEntity instanceof CustomCampaignEntityAPI) {
487                        ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)stationEntity).setRadius(radius);
488                } else if (stationEntity.hasTag(Tags.USE_STATION_VISUAL)) {
489                        ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI)stationEntity).setRadius(radius);
490                }
491                
492                boolean skeletonMode = !isFunctional();
493                
494                if (skeletonMode) {
495                        stationEntity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.STATION_FLEET);
496                        stationEntity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.STATION_BASE_FLEET, stationFleet);
497                        stationEntity.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(stationFleet);
498                        
499                        for (int i = 1; i < member.getStatus().getNumStatuses(); i++) {
500                                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
501                                if (i > 0) {
502                                        String slotId = member.getVariant().getModuleSlots().get(i - 1);
503                                        variant = variant.getModuleVariant(slotId);
504                                } else {
505                                        continue;
506                                }
507                                
508                                if (!variant.hasHullMod(HullMods.VASTBULK)) {
509                                        member.getStatus().setDetached(i, true);
510                                        member.getStatus().setPermaDetached(i, true);
511                                        member.getStatus().setHullFraction(i, 0f);
512                                }
513                        }
514                        
515                } else {
516                        stationEntity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.STATION_BASE_FLEET);
517                        stationEntity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.STATION_FLEET, stationFleet);
518//                      stationFleet.setBattle(null);
519//                      stationFleet.setNoEngaging(0);
520                        stationEntity.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(stationFleet);
521                        stationFleet.setExpired(false);
522                        stationEntity.getContainingLocation().addEntity(stationFleet);
523                }
524        }

526        protected int getHumanCommanderLevel() {
527                boolean battlestation = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_BATTLESTATION);
528                boolean starfortress = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_STARFORTRESS);
529                
530                if (starfortress) {
531                        return Global.getSettings().getInt("tier3StationOfficerLevel");
532                } else if (battlestation) {
533                        return Global.getSettings().getInt("tier2StationOfficerLevel");
534                }
535                return Global.getSettings().getInt("tier1StationOfficerLevel");
536        }

619        public void reportFleetDespawnedToListener(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param) {
620                if (fleet != stationFleet) return; // shouldn't happen...
621                
622                disrupt(this);
623                
624                // bug where somehow a station fleet can become empty as a result of combat
625                // then its despawn() gets called every frame
626                if (stationFleet.getMembersWithFightersCopy().isEmpty()) {
627                        matchStationAndCommanderToCurrentIndustry();
628                }
629                stationFleet.setAbortDespawn(true);
630        }

632        public static void disrupt(Industry station) {
633                station.setDisrupted(station.getSpec().getBuildTime() * 0.5f, true);
634        }

636        public boolean isAvailableToBuild() {
637                //if (getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_PARENT)) return true;
638                
639                boolean canBuild = false;
640                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
641                        if (ind == this) continue;
642                        if (!ind.isFunctional()) continue;
643                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_SPACEPORT)) {
644                                canBuild = true;
645                                break;
646                        }
647                }
648                return canBuild;
649        }

658                boolean battlestation = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_BATTLESTATION);
659                boolean starfortress = getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_STARFORTRESS);
660                int stabilityMod = 1;
661                if (battlestation) {
662                        stabilityMod = 2;
663                } else if (starfortress) {
664                        stabilityMod = 3;
665                }
666                return stabilityMod;
667        }

688        protected void addAlphaCoreDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, AICoreDescriptionMode mode) {
689                float opad = 10f;
690                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
691                
692                String pre = "Alpha-level AI core currently assigned. ";
693                if (mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.MANAGE_CORE_DIALOG_LIST || mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
694                        pre = "Alpha-level AI core. ";
695                }
696                if (mode == AICoreDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
697                        CommoditySpecAPI coreSpec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(aiCoreId);
698                        TooltipMakerAPI text = tooltip.beginImageWithText(coreSpec.getIconName(), 48);
699                        text.addPara(pre + "Reduces upkeep cost by %s. Reduces demand by %s unit. " +
700                                        "Increases station combat effectiveness.", 0f, highlight,
701                                        "" + (int)((1f - UPKEEP_MULT) * 100f) + "%", "" + DEMAND_REDUCTION);
702                        tooltip.addImageWithText(opad);
703                        return;
704                }
705                
706                tooltip.addPara(pre + "Reduces upkeep cost by %s. Reduces demand by %s unit. " +
707                                "Increases station combat effectiveness.", opad, highlight,
708                                "" + (int)((1f - UPKEEP_MULT) * 100f) + "%", "" + DEMAND_REDUCTION);
709                
710        }

717        protected void applyImproveModifiers() {

719                        market.getStability().modifyFlat("orbital_station_improve", IMPROVE_STABILITY_BONUS, 
720                                                getImprovementsDescForModifiers() + " (" + getNameForModifier() + ")");

726        public void addImproveDesc(TooltipMakerAPI info, ImprovementDescriptionMode mode) {
727                float opad = 10f;
728                Color highlight = Misc.getHighlightColor();
729                
730                
731                if (mode == ImprovementDescriptionMode.INDUSTRY_TOOLTIP) {
732                        info.addPara("Stability increased by %s.", 0f, highlight, "" + (int) IMPROVE_STABILITY_BONUS);
733                } else {
734                        info.addPara("Increases stability by %s.", 0f, highlight, "" + (int) IMPROVE_STABILITY_BONUS);
735                }
736
737                info.addSpacer(opad);
